title: SubjectParts, BlockMetadata, BlockLocation lack Debug — makes test output opaque
description: SubjectParts (uuencoding-multi/src/lib.rs line 129), BlockLocation (uuencoding/src/lib.rs line 129), and ScannedBlock (line 145) do not derive Debug. SubjectParts in particular is returned by parse_subject() and will appear in assertion failures as '<SubjectParts>' rather than showing field values. BlockMetadata derives Debug but ScannedBlock and BlockLocation do not. Developers writing tests will see unhelpful output when assertions fail. (Note: DecodedBlock and InlineUUBlock do derive Debug.)
acceptance_criteria: Derive Debug on SubjectParts, BlockLocation, and ScannedBlock.
close_reason: Derived Debug on BlockLocation and ScannedBlock in uuencoding/src/lib.rs, and SubjectParts in uuencoding-multi/src/lib.rs
